sentences.en: My grandmother has lived in the same house by the sea for sixty years.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶在同一座海边的房子里住了六十年。

sentences.en: Every winter, the waves come a little closer to her door.
sentences.zh: 每年冬天，海浪都会离她的门口近一点。

sentences.en: Last month, the town council offered to buy her land.
sentences.zh: 上个月，镇议会提出买下她的土地。

sentences.en: She wrote back in one sentence: "I would rather move the sea."
sentences.zh: 她只回了一句话：“我宁愿把海搬走。”

rather.zh: 宁愿（would rather 意为宁可）

sentences.en: We all laughed, and then nobody spoke for a while.
sentences.zh: 我们都笑了，然后有一阵子谁也没说话。
